data.name: StudyHub
data.detailed_description:
StudyHub: Global library, open 24/7

StudyHub is a peaceful, ever-evolving workspace designed to break the monotony of working alone. Find your focus in a distraction-free environment and join a global community to achieve your goals together.

✅ Current Features (Available Now)

The current Early Access version focuses on personal productivity tools in a cozy atmosphere.

  • Personal Study Sessions: Start your own session and stay on track with the integrated timer.

  • To-Do List: Manage your daily tasks in-game and tick them off as you go.

  • Sticky Notes: Personalize your desk with reminders, goals, or motivational quotes.

  • Calming Atmosphere: A minimalist, cozy environment designed to help you reach a state of flow.

  • StudyHub Radio: Listen to focus-enhancing lo-fi beats while you work.

🚀 Early Access Roadmap (Coming Soon)

StudyHub is growing into a digital campus. We are actively working on these features for future updates:

The Library Expansion & Multiplayer

  • 3rd Floor Private Rooms: Dedicated spaces for groups with Voice Chat enabled for collaborative study.

  • Public Study Floors: Open areas to focus together using text chat in a quiet environment.

  • Group Study Sessions: Sync your timers with others at multi-person tables.

  • Interactive Idea Board: A space to brainstorm, draw, and connect dots for your projects.

Social & Customization

  • The Cafe & Outdoors: Social areas with Voice Chat enabled for breaks.

  • Expanded Character Customization: Express your style with new clothes and accessories.

  • Desk Decoration: Decorate your personal desk with various items.

  • Break Time Activities: Chess, pixel art, and relaxing social zones.

  • Personal Journal: Reflect on your daily progress.

data.short_description: StudyHub is a peaceful online workspace where you can focus alongside people from around the world. Manage your tasks and reach your goals in a shared environment that supports up to 60 people per server.

  • Storage: 3 GB available space
